title: U.S. investigated Chinese spy plot aimed at Nvidia CEO
summary: A top executive of a Singapore AI cloud company that was accused of illegally selling Nvidia chips to China could also have been a Chinese spy, sources have told the New York Times.

title: Ex-Palantir execs launch Dream with $17M from a16z to build AI world models for construction
summary: rained on 100 million square feet of building permits, dream wants to disrupt Autodesk with AI.

title: SuperMe raises $20M for its network of AI expert profiles
summary: SuperMe is a network of AI profiles built from the knowledge of real-life experts. When you ask a question, the platform determines which experts are best suited to answer and creates a group chat with their AI profiles.

title: Agent identity startup Mintive lands Cowboy Ventures, Coatue, angels Jeff Dean, Andrej Karpathy
summary: Mintive was founded by two engineers who have been working on AI for decades through Google Brain and Coursera. It's platform promises to help IT easily control enterprise agents.

title: Wabi, the AI agent that builds mini apps, now valued at $1.25B after latest round
summary: On Thursday, AI app Wabi, now describing itself as a "personal agent," said it has raised $55 million at a $1.25 billion valuation.

title: Bluesky blocks links to leaked DHS employee data as government seeks takedowns
summary: The social networking site is facing criticism for blocking access to the site, which identifies thousands of ICE agents and other employees working for Homeland Security.

title: DoorDash to acquire Instacart for $17B
summary: The acquisition would bring two major players in on-demand delivery under one roof, combining DoorDash’s dominance in restaurant takeout with Instacart’s reach in grocery delivery.

title: Deepgram acquires Pipecat-maker Daily to bolster its voice AI infrastructure
summary: With Pipecat, Deepgram will likely gain a deeper understanding of real-time voice and video infrastructure.

title: Amazon updates Alexa to help you manage shopping lists and subscriptions and update delivery instructions
summary: The update allows you to use Alexa to create lists, register them, see what's on them, and add or edit items. You can also manage subscriptions.

title: Who will you learn from in 6 days at TechCrunch Founder Summit? Meet the founders and investors taking the stages
summary: Six days from now, on November 4, TechCrunch Founder Summit brings experienced founders, investors, and operators to Boston to share the decisions, mistakes, pivots, and lessons that shaped their companies. Register before it starts for ticket savings and deals.

title: Upwind raises $400M after walking away from Datadog acquisition offer
summary: The cloud security startup raised a Series C at a $3.8B valuation, instead of selling itself for the same price.

title: Apple’s touchscreen MacBook Pro pushes laptop pricing to a new extreme
summary: Prepare to cough up around $14,549 if you want the new touchscreen MacBook Pro to have every upgrade.

title: Microsoft just shared Azure’s actual revenue in dollars: $33.2 billion
summary: Microsoft has never disclosed Azure's quarterly revenue in dollars. But for the first time, we can see just how close it is getting to besting the biggest competitor in the market, AWS.

title: Google expands AI Search ads globally as core ad growth slows
summary: The announcement came alongside parent company Alphabet's third-quarter earnings report, which saw revenue grow 25% year over year to $127.6 billion.

title: Microsoft recorded $10 billion in revenue from OpenAI
summary: Microsoft said it made $10 billion in revenue from commercial arrangements with OpenAI, including revenue-sharing payments, in the quarter ending September 30. It underscores the still-enormous financial dependency of the partnership.

title: Microsoft hits 10 quarters of record-breaking revenue in a row
summary: Whatever the future of AI might be, the current situation is still very good for Microsoft. The tech giant reported yet another record for quarterly revenue on Wednesday: $92.3 billion, a 19% increase over the year-ago quarter.

title: Hacker stole personnel data about thousands of Homeland Security employees, including CBP and ICE agents
summary: A hacker obtained personally identifiable information about more than 40,000 Homeland Security staffers, which has since been published online.

title: Anthropic just launched tools to show companies what their AI spending is buying
summary: The frontier lab is lifting the curtain on how users spend money on its models ahead of a planned IPO.

summary: The PHP scare may have faded from your feed, but the cleanup is far from over. Last week, two critical bugs in the open source language behind roughly 70% of websites left organizations scrambling to fix their systems, with some taking sites offline until the vulnerabilities could be patched. title: Apple launches its new touchscreen MacBook Pro
summary: Apple's new touchscreen MacBook Pro starts at $2,899.
